item.text:
### (a) Three social posts

1. We believe this plainly: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, no human will ever need to work again. Work will become a choice, not a condition of survival.

2. We stand for a future where nobody has to earn the right to live. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, no human will ever need to work again. Our time will finally be ours.

3. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, no human will ever need to work again. We welcome that future: freedom to care, create, explore and contribute because we want to—not because we need a paycheck.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, no human will ever need to work again. We mean an end to work as an economic necessity, not an end to purpose, ambition or contribution. We will be free to raise families, build communities, pursue discoveries and make art without tying our survival to a paycheck. We reject the idea that our worth depends on our productivity. We see this future as liberation: the freedom to decide how we spend our lives. Our task now is to demand that this extraordinary abundance belongs to everyone, rather than becoming the private reward of a few.
